resources.name: Open-source DFT package with optical properties capability

access.notes: Quantum ESPRESSO, ABINIT, or Elk; must support independent-particle dielectric function calculations.

resources.notes: Choose a version that can compute momentum matrix elements and dielectric functions. Quantum ESPRESSO with epsilon.x or a similar post-processing tool is sufficient.

resources.name: Pseudopotentials for Cs, Sn, Cl, Br, I

access.notes: SSSP library or PseudoDojo; both provide well-tested norm-conserving and ultrasoft pseudopotentials.

resources.notes: Standard pseudopotentials for all elements; the agent can download them from the library.
